text:
Maya: quick heads-up on Quillix onboarding — their 95th pct latency for chat is trending up (420ms -> 720ms) after traffic spike yesterday. worried about renewal signals if we don't act.
Ravi: thanks for flagging. are errors increasing too or just latency?
Maya: errors steady, but UI timeouts hitting some pages. their success manager noted customers seeing slow suggestions during flows.
Gabe: could be KV cache churn + large seq lengths. can you share sample request sizes?
Maya: most sessions are short prompts (~120 tokens) but some long context uses for summarization (~2.5k).
Linh: two quick levers: 1) model variant swap (move long-context to an 8-bit quantized variant), 2) route short prompts to a cheaper fast path. both are nonbreaking and reversible.
Maya: that sounds good. have a proposed model to swap to?
Gabe: recommend: redwood/cascade-8k-q4_8 for long-context summarization (keeps quality, 4-bit-ish memory) and redwood/streamline-3b for short chat. should shave 30-50% latency on those flows.
Ravi: schedule-wise — we should do a canary with 10% traffic tonight, measure p95 and cpu/gpu util, then roll to 50% if green. can we automate fallback on errors?
Linh: yes — use routing policy with health checks + automatic fallback. example route snippet to attach to their workspace:
```json
{"routes": [{"match": "metadata.intent == \"summarize\" && tokens > 800", "model": "redwood/cascade-8k-q4_8", "weight": 0.1}, {"match": "tokens <= 800", "model": "redwood/streamline-3b", "weight": 0.9}], "fallback": "redwood/cascade-8k-pt"}
```
Gabe: also enable prefix KV caching for repeated context — add header X-Enable-KV: true on recurrent calls. that cut cost for another customer by ~22%.
Maya: can we quantify expected cost delta for Quillix? they'll ask during the renewal sync.
Gabe: rough estimate: model swap + q4 quantization should reduce tokens GPU cost ~35% for summarization flows, overall infra spend down ~18% assuming current mix. i'll run a quick calc and post numbers.
Ravi: I'll book a 30-min enablement demo with Quillix PM and engineering. want Gabe and Linh on the call to walk the rollout plan and config. available tomorrow 10:00 PT?
Gabe: yes.
Linh: yes — i'll bring a short playbook and the exact routing json.
Maya: I'll prep a one-pager for the renewal owner showing the perf gains + rollback plan. we should capture post-canary metrics: p50/p95/p99, error rate, cost per 1k tokens.
deploy-bot: Deploy request queued: route-change-quillix-canary (10%) by Linh. status: pending approval.
Ravi: approving now.
Maya: thanks team. will update in the renewal tracker and post results here after the canary (aiming for results by EOD tomorrow). :thumbsup:
Gabe: posting simulated numbers in thread after calc.
Linh: added checklist to the canary runbook: DB of prompts to run, synthetic load at 1.5x, and alert thresholds.
Maya: perfect. capturing customer feedback items too (UX timeout wording + telemetry hooks).
Ravi: reminder — record the enablement call so AM can reuse clips for docs.
Maya: done. will attach recording + playbook in the customer record.
Gabe: preliminary calc: estimated p95 reduction from 720ms -> ~360ms for affected flows, cost delta -20% overall. will refine after live metrics.
Maya: awesome. thanks all.
